site.name: Bengaluru Warehouse 01
site.provenance: Layout, dock, rack and resource counts copied from the SYNTHETIC world seed vorg-seed/bengaluru-warehouse-01/v1 (docs/scenarios/bengaluru-warehouse-01.md). Not measured from a real warehouse.

storage.note: Ground-floor racks A-rr-cc and B-rr-cc (7 x 5 each, 4 levels, 6 slots per level as placed by the seed). The 8 mezzanine small-parts racks are excluded: not forklift pallet storage.

inbound_truck_arrival_rate_per_hour.label: ASSUMPTION
inbound_truck_arrival_rate_per_hour.rationale: Poisson arrivals at a constant rate over the shift; chosen so the three inbound docks are occupied a little over half of the time. No arrival history exists to calibrate against.

inbound_pallets_per_truck.label: ASSUMPTION
inbound_pallets_per_truck.rationale: Mixed partial and full truckloads; a full 32 ft truck carries about 22-24 standard pallets.

inbound_unload_lanes_per_truck.label: ASSUMPTION
inbound_unload_lanes_per_truck.rationale: At most two forklifts work one dock door at a time (one at the trailer, one at the staging lane).

dock_in_time_min.label: ASSUMPTION
dock_in_time_min.rationale: Reverse onto the door, chock, open the leveller and check documents before the first pallet moves.

dock_out_time_min.label: ASSUMPTION
dock_out_time_min.rationale: Close and seal, sign documents and pull out; the door is occupied until the truck leaves.

unload_time_per_pallet_min.label: ASSUMPTION
unload_time_per_pallet_min.rationale: Forklift cycle trailer to receiving lane and back (short distance), including occasional repositioning.

receiving_check_time_per_pallet_min.label: ASSUMPTION
receiving_check_time_per_pallet_min.rationale: A receiving worker scans the label and checks quantity/damage before the pallet is released for putaway.

putaway_handling_time_min.label: ASSUMPTION
putaway_handling_time_min.rationale: Pick up, lift to the rack level and place; travel is added separately from the layout distance.

forklift_speed_m_per_s.label: ASSUMPTION
forklift_speed_m_per_s.rationale: Average loaded/unloaded travel speed (7.2 km/h) inside a building with pedestrians; travel distance is the Manhattan distance between zone centres along the aisles.

inbound_turnaround_target_min.label: ASSUMPTION
inbound_turnaround_target_min.rationale: Service-level target for an inbound truck from gate arrival to departure; used only to count SLA misses.

order_arrival_rate_per_hour.label: ASSUMPTION
order_arrival_rate_per_hour.rationale: Poisson order release; with about 2 pallets per order this roughly balances the inbound pallet flow.

pallets_per_order.label: ASSUMPTION
pallets_per_order.rationale: Outbound orders of one to four pallet equivalents, small orders most common (mean 2.05).

retrieval_handling_time_min.label: ASSUMPTION
retrieval_handling_time_min.rationale: Lower the pallet from the rack and set it down in the picking zone; travel is added from the layout distance.

pick_time_per_pallet_min.label: ASSUMPTION
pick_time_per_pallet_min.rationale: A picker builds one outbound pallet from one storage pallet (pallet-level abstraction, ADR-48); includes moving it to packing.

pack_time_per_pallet_min.label: ASSUMPTION
pack_time_per_pallet_min.rationale: Stretch-wrap, label and move the pallet into dispatch staging (manual pallet jack, not forklift-modeled).

order_cycle_time_target_min.label: ASSUMPTION
order_cycle_time_target_min.rationale: Same-shift dispatch target from order release to the departure of the truck carrying its last pallet.

outbound_truck_arrival_rate_per_hour.label: ASSUMPTION
outbound_truck_arrival_rate_per_hour.rationale: Poisson arrivals of outbound trucks (carrier pickups); capacity exceeds the mean outbound flow by about 25%.

outbound_truck_capacity_pallets.label: ASSUMPTION
outbound_truck_capacity_pallets.rationale: Pallet positions of the carriers' trucks.

outbound_load_lanes_per_truck.label: ASSUMPTION
outbound_load_lanes_per_truck.rationale: Two forklift + dispatch-worker teams load one truck in parallel.

load_time_per_pallet_min.label: ASSUMPTION
load_time_per_pallet_min.rationale: Forklift cycle dispatch staging to trailer, with a dispatch worker checking the load.

outbound_max_dwell_min.label: ASSUMPTION
outbound_max_dwell_min.rationale: Loading window: a docked outbound truck stops loading when full or when this long has passed since loading started, then leaves (carrier schedule).
